column1: # Game profile of Mario Kart World (Switch 2, 1.0.0). Bring-up in progress: see README.md
# Nintendo's sead / agl / gsys engine with NintendoWare and Havok, on SDK 19.3.3 (NintendoSDK_NVN-19_3_3), NVN2; Pia and NPLN networking.
# subsdk0 is the movie library. RomFS: 205,788 files (23.3 GB), zstd-compressed (.zs) resources; shaders in Shader/*.Nin_Ounce_NVN2.bfsha.zs
# main.npdm's ACID has the Switch 2 layout (a 0x300-byte signature area)
# The Switch 2's 12 GB layout gives an application a pool of 9809 MiB (app_pool 0x265100000), which GetInfo TotalMemorySize reports. MKW's nninitStartup (main+0xc387b4) sets a heap
# of (total - used) rounded down to 2 MB, less 0x60400000 (1540 MB kept for its other allocators): 0x200d00000, just over 8 GiB, with the 64 MB of used memory the host reports. The heap
# region (mem_reserve - 256 MB - alias - stack) is 8.25 GiB to hold it; only the pages the game touches take memory. The NPDM declares 64 MB of system resource (virtual address memory)

# where MKW's NVN2 shaders live (shader_split.py): Shader/*.bfsha and the Drive sarc's BAHS, Layout/*.blarc BNSH, Effect esetb BNSH, Lib/ (agl, gsys, sead, Terrain, Visualizer); main's own BNSH go to 'main'
